kind: original first-person glove hands, two poses (visual game asset)
texture_source: public/assets/blender/textures (the delivered 1024px JPEGs, reused byte-identical; originals untouched)

axes.authoring: glove-local: fingers -z, back of hand +y, thumb -x, cuff +z (consumed verbatim)
axes.map: game_x = x, game_y = y, game_z = z (identity bake); kit glove() orients the group with a per-pose basis

anchors_glove_local.palm: spans the origin in x, y and z

build_time_checks.anchor_contract: each palm spans the origin, every wrist/strap/sleeve/bracer part stays at z > 0.018, no vertex leaves a 0.25 m radius, every finger has a bare distal phalanx
build_time_checks.part_contact: every authored part must touch or nearly touch another part of its own pose; a group that only meets the model through empty space is reported as floating and fails the build
build_time_checks.finger_gaps: neighbouring proximal stalls keep >= 1.5 mm of air between them

limitations: Scalar metallic/roughness only: no baked normal, occlusion or roughness maps.
Single LOD; no mobile GPU profiling.
Static poses: deliberately no rig or runtime IK.
notes: Revision 2: base-knuckle flexion, rounded phalanx joints without ball bumps, half-finger glove with bare middle/distal phalanges, RIVET kit colours.
The runtime keeps these materials as delivered (no glove-map re-texture) and keys the character-skin palette on the material name.
